semantic.justification: S3HW1E HTML50: actual SwPaM owns original permanent m_Bound1/m_Bound2 positions and Point/Mark aliases. A single-position constructor initializes the inactive bound at node0; SetMark reuses the opposite physical bound, Exchange swaps aliases, DeleteMark parks only a formerly active mark at node0, Assign retains physical owners, Normalize keeps original default true, and Start/End retain Point/Mark equality ties. The existing point-first TypeScript argument binding is preserved for callers rather than reinterpreting source parameter order. Original lcl_PosCorrAbs uses inclusive comparisons and value assignment; lcl_PaMCorrAbs visits both physical bounds without short circuit, including an inactive bound. Native GetCorrPosition retains a content endpoint when available and otherwise chooses the actual structural/content successor of End, with no nearest-paragraph fallback. Original SwContentIndex GetContentNode is nullable for a valid unattached/structural position; the old disposed-only throw/freed-owner fixture is removed in favor of genuine unowned-index validation. Actual document, node, index, PaM and caption owners are used without private parser/result injection, alternate selection state or a fabricated global cursor provider. Global PaMCorrAbs edit-shell/UNO-cursor traversal, actual DeleteSection/DelNodes composition, table grammar/materialization/layout, RTF direction export and final filter/UI audit remain required; whole module/API/ABI/native lifetime parity remains unverified and browser file/autosave/recovery deviations are unchanged.
